assignment.adaptation: Each fixed algorithm may fit only its allowed 18-position prefix at inference; no global tuning on evaluation outcomes.
assignment.evaluation: all selected distinct IDs; all their positions remain evaluation-group data
assignment.excluded: all unselected IDs; selected failures stay attempted evaluation groups

eligibility.future_truth_gate: No future-position distance/speed/error exclusion; missing/invalid truth is explicitly unavailable, never a selection replacement
eligibility.no_extra_quality_filter: Published location_type/experiment are descriptors only; no new drogue or sensor accuracy claim
pre_score_metadata_only: exact 24 finite parsed positions in requested order with regular one-hour UTC cadence
all18 prefix positions within fixed computational geometry domain

limitations: NOAA hourly positions are QC/interpolated retrospective products and may use future raw fixes upstream.
Unseen drifter IDs are disjoint from development but ocean/time blocks and nearby deployments need not be statistically independent.
Only a six-drifter feasibility study; no significance, operational prediction, source attribution, reef impact, or automatic model promotion.
Models adapt on permitted observation prefixes; unseen refers to unscored groups, not a single globally trained model with no adaptation.

metrics.conditional_success_metrics: Optional common-success subset clearly labelled, identical all-four-model cohort and full attempted/failure denominators; no ranking or promotion
metrics.paired_skill: 1-sum(candidate trajectory mean errors)/sum(baseline trajectory mean errors); zero denominator ->null ZERO_BASELINE_ERROR
metrics.per_horizon: error per model per drifter; equal-drifter macro mean and RMS with attempted/scored/failed counts
metrics.primary_macro: equal-weight mean trajectory errors across the complete declared selected cohort; withhold if any required group/model/horizon missing
metrics.trajectory_summary: mean of six hourly position errors per model; not six independent replicates

origin.justification: 24 observed hours exactly support the unchanged 18-position fit plus six fixed forecast horizons, not an asserted physical ocean validity timescale.

preprocessing.geometry: Existing spherical azimuthal equidistant frame centered on first prefix position; great-circle errors in metres

geometry_justification.note: The inherited 50 km cap bounds local spherical-map tangential distortion near 10.3ppm; sphere/ellipsoid discrepancy is larger and is not forecast uncertainty. Prefix/domain failures stay in attempted coverage; future truth is not filtered by local distance.

purpose: Fixed-model retrospective motion comparison on metadata-selected previously unscored drifter groups; no model selection or plastic attribution.

selection.justification: Three prechosen ocean/time blocks provide a modest diverse feasibility cohort; boundaries and decades are workload/design choices, not an independence guarantee. Snapshot positions are selection metadata, not scored forecast outcomes.
